methods.M1: Bind explicit row type/local type to its literal own Wikidata P31 and unique own TERC (whole rural/mixed gmina) or own SIMC (RM=96, SYM=SYMPOD town). Town uses TERC kind 1 or 4, never kind 3. Own seven-digit TERC must agree where present; an additional four-digit TERC is compatible only for the identical powiat prefix of a city with county rights. Require row/own point within 5 km, no own point beyond 20 km, confirmed official name, same wojewodztwo, exact typed powiat name/state, and matching explicit parent where present. Read Tabela_III.xls C, 2026-06-30. No unresolved key is admitted.
methods.M2: Bind village/locality by its literal own SIMC and P31, matching official RM/SYMPOD, point, wojewodztwo, powiat and gmina. Use 2021 statistical catalogue SYMSTAT only if it equals the own SIMC, all group members have SYMPOD equal to that SIMC, and the only independent SYM=SYMPOD member is the same place. Integral parts belong to that basic village; distinct basic settlements never enter its count. Require same hierarchy in census/current registers, BDL parent TERC equivalence, same official label, and unqualified integer 1639616 total at 2021-03-31. Missing source records, conflicts and unresolved keys are held.
methods.hold: Held values and years are retained verbatim and are not certified as correct. Census API zero records without a province filter is not evidence of absent population. census_inventory.json distinguishes complete/partial/missing provinces and preserves rate-limit receipts.
